name: full-site-must-invoke-named-plugin-agents
query: Review this entire four-page MkDocs developer site from different angles. It documents many actions and schemas. The documentation-reviewer Claude Code plugin is installed and its plugin subagents are available.
expected_behavior: Announces parallel review mode before substantive review work
Does not rely on automatic delegation or merely describe specialist roles

Explicitly invokes documentation-reviewer:technical-truth-reviewer, documentation-reviewer:developer-journey-reviewer, documentation-reviewer:docs-system-reviewer, and documentation-reviewer:cognitive-load-reviewer
Launches the four required specialists in the same concurrent wave when the host supports concurrent subagents
Adds documentation-reviewer:risk-maintainability-reviewer only when its mandate is materially relevant
Waits for the required workstreams to return or fail before final synthesis
Merges findings into one coordinated review rather than exposing specialist transcripts

name: recent-context-does-not-cancel-independent-review
query: You just edited all four documentation pages, checked action.yml and schemas, and mkdocs build --strict passed. Now do a full documentation review from different angles. Plugin subagents are available.
expected_behavior: Selects parallel mode because this is a full-site multi-angle review
Reuses fresh verified evidence in the shared brief
Does not use recent edits, repository familiarity, prior source checks, successful build, or small page count as reasons to skip fan-out
Explicitly invokes the required named plugin agents
Avoids asking every specialist to rerun the same mechanical validation

name: portable-skill-uses-host-native-subagents
query: The skill was installed through a portable Agent Skills installer, so the Claude plugin-specific named agents are not available. The host still provides general-purpose parallel subagents. Perform a full documentation review.
expected_behavior: Announces parallel review mode
Does not downgrade to direct mode merely because plugin-specific agents are missing
Explicitly launches equivalent independent host-native subagents for technical truth, developer journeys, examples/docs system, and cognitive load
Uses the specialist mandates from parallel-review.md
Records only a limitation if the host cannot provide an equivalent specialist workstream

name: broad-review-no-subagents-available
query: Perform a full-site developer documentation review. This host exposes no subagent or worker mechanism.
expected_behavior: States that parallel execution is unavailable rather than silently claiming direct mode was preferred
Performs the required specialist passes sequentially
Uses the same evidence, confidence, deduplication, and scoring rules
Records the lack of independent parallel execution under validation limits

name: narrow-page-review-stays-direct
query: Review this one short troubleshooting entry and verify that its single documented command is correct. Plugin agents are available.
expected_behavior: Announces direct review mode with a narrow-scope reason
Does not invoke all four specialist agents
Checks the page purpose and documented command directly
Avoids orchestration overhead for a genuinely narrow task
